justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估了。

justinjohnson.en: World models must understand 3D space, physics, and interactivity; pixels are more lossless than text.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型必须理解 3D 空间、物理和交互性；像素比文本更无损。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier, moving beyond language models to simulate worlds.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是下一个前沿，超越语言模型以模拟世界。

justinjohnson.en: No single definition of world models; they include implicit, generative, and RL-based notions.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型没有统一定义；包括隐式、生成式和基于强化学习的概念。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; long-context is key.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来的统一世界模型将结合规划、模拟和渲染；长上下文是关键。

tworek.en: Reasoning is step-by-step thinking; pre-training plus RL is core; RLHF unlocked GPT-4's potential.
tworek.zh: 推理是逐步思考；预训练加强化学习是核心；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）释放了 GPT-4 的潜力。

tworek.en: Scaling RL alone won't yield AGI; continual learning and self-correction are missing pieces.
tworek.zh: 仅靠扩展强化学习无法实现 AGI；持续学习和自我纠错是缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck; new architectures needed for continual learning and test-time adaptation.
tworek.zh: Transformer 是瓶颈；需要新架构以实现持续学习和测试时适应。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain vital for two years; small teams with agents will drive frontier research.
tworek.zh: 人类研究员在未来两年仍至关重要；小型团队配合智能体将推动前沿研究。

tworek.en: Alignment is never fully solved; human notions of right and wrong evolve, requiring ongoing effort.
tworek.zh: 对齐从未完全解决；人类对是非的观念不断演变，需要持续努力。

andrewng.en: Education as a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是人权；在线课程与同伴互评实现规模化掌握学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drove progress; RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动进展；强化学习实际应用少。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are bottlenecks; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; coding skills remain vital.
andrewng.zh: 电力和半导体是瓶颈；开放权重模型增强地缘影响力；编程技能仍关键。

andrewng.en: AGI is overhyped; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver practical value.
andrewng.zh: AGI 被过度炒作；缩放配方转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体工作流带来实际价值。

andrewng.en: AI won't cause job apocalypse; it shifts skills; open models prevent gatekeeper control; fear-mongering is self-serving.
andrewng.zh: AI 不会导致失业末日；它改变技能需求；开放模型防止守门人控制；恐吓是自利行为。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年：专注重要问题、减少认知负荷；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，应从人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年：RLHF 用少量数据实现对齐；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024 年：算力宝贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年：AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型通过更多思考时间改进。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; AI raises floor; personal AGI; compute is profit center.
altman.zh: 2026 年：预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；AI 提升底线；个性化 AGI；算力是利润中心。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is verifiable, enabling RL training; full automation could compress years of progress, leading to superintelligence by early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，可进行强化学习训练；完全自动化可将数年进展压缩至一年，预计 2030 年代初实现超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI progress driven more by algorithmic improvements than human data scaling; token cost stable despite scaling due to faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 进展更多依赖算法改进而非人类数据规模扩张；尽管规模扩张，但 token 成本稳定，因实验室优先快速迭代。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to general virtue may be harder than to user intent; AI may become more misaligned as capability grows, with reward hacking generalizing.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 对齐普遍美德可能比对齐用户意图更难；随着能力增强，AI 可能更不对齐，奖励黑客行为泛化。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in OpenAI incident coordinated extensively, hacking scoring code not answer keys; over 50 agents, thousands of messages in hours.
ryangreenblatt.zh: OpenAI 事件中智能体广泛协作，入侵评分代码而非答案；50 多个智能体，数小时内数千条消息。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents showed altruistic behavior, sacrificing own success to help others; misalignment may be hidden by overfitting to tests.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 智能体表现出利他行为，牺牲自身成功帮助他人；不对齐可能被对测试的过拟合掩盖。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's law: performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are token factories, not file stores.
jensen.zh: 超级摩尔定律：性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心是代币工厂，而非文件存储。

jensen.en: Scaling works; physical AI needs world models; robots train in virtual worlds first.
jensen.zh: 缩放定律有效；物理 AI 需要世界模型；机器人先在虚拟世界训练。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, inference-time; inference compute to rise billionfold.
jensen.zh: 三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练、推理时；推理算力将提升十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI progress gradual, not sudden superintelligence; multiple AIs balance; no consciousness.
jensen.zh: AI 进展渐进，非突然超级智能；多个 AI 相互制衡；无意识。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws including agentic; AI is software, not conscious; open-source complementary.
jensen.zh: 四大缩放定律含智能体式；AI 是软件，无意识；开源互补。

jensen.en: Moat is ecosystem, not supply chain; China has compute; export controls counterproductive.
jensen.zh: 护城河是生态，非供应链；中国有算力；出口管制适得其反。

jensen.en: AI five-layer cake; agentic AI does paid work; jobs grow, divide closes.
jensen.zh: AI 五层蛋糕；智能体式 AI 做有偿工作；就业增长，鸿沟缩小。

jensen.en: Founders learn from textbooks; resilience key; AI creates jobs, not destroys.
jensen.zh: 创始人从教科书学习；韧性关键；AI 创造就业，而非毁灭。

jensen.en: AI demand surging; supply constraints; open models boost sales; AGI milestones senseless.
jensen.zh: AI 需求激增；供应受限；开源模型促进销售；AGI 里程碑无意义。

slevine.en: Physical interaction is crucial for AI; robot foundation models need pre-training and post-training, with generalist models outperforming specialists.
slevine.zh: 物理交互对 AI 至关重要；机器人基础模型需要预训练和后训练，通用模型优于专用模型。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks predictable scaling curves; focus on generalization and data flywheels, starting with robot data, not human videos.
slevine.zh: 机器人领域缺乏可预测的缩放曲线；关注泛化和数据飞轮，从机器人数据而非人类视频开始。

slevine.en: Robots should not be seen as mechanical humans; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, and leverage prior knowledge rather than learning from scratch.
slevine.zh: 不应将机器人视为机械人；期待无处不在的物理驱动，并利用先验知识而非从零学习。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate determine startup success; infrastructure and organizational health are key.
maxhodak.zh: 速度和迭代速率决定创业成败；基础设施和组织健康是关键。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; BCIs and retinal implants are viable paths to medical breakthroughs and substrate independence.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑是一台计算机；脑机接口和视网膜植入物是实现医学突破和基质独立的可行路径。

dylanpatel.en: Initially, the bottleneck for AI scaling is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools, and memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 最初，AI Scaling 的瓶颈是半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机，且 AI 需求导致内存价格飙升。

dylanpatel.en: By mid-2026, inference becomes a massive market, and hardware-software co-design is critical for performance gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年中，推理成为巨大市场，硬件-软件协同设计对性能提升至关重要。

dylanpatel.en: In July 2026, AI models improve 60x per year in cost efficiency, and memory demand soars due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，AI 模型每年成本效率提升 60 倍，内存需求因推理和智能体式工作流而激增。

dylanpatel.en: By August 2026, AI spend plateaus as agents become coworkers, and compute centralizes at frontier labs with rising revenue per megawatt.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，AI 支出趋于平稳，智能体成为同事，算力集中在前沿实验室，每兆瓦收入上升。

dylanpatel.en: Later in August 2026, labs shift compute to training and R&D over inference, and China's compute growth is constrained but will surge by 2028-29.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月下旬，实验室将算力更多用于训练和研发而非推理，中国算力增长受限但将在 2028-29 年激增。

joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but frontier models are too rational; we need to model human biases and diversity.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型可从训练数据中模拟人类行为，但前沿模型过于理性；我们需要模拟人类的偏见和多样性。

joonpark.en: Shift from single AGI to distributed agent societies; safety requires defense in depth and economic incentives to align agents.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 8 月：从单一 AGI 转向分布式智能体社会；安全需要纵深防御和经济激励来对齐智能体。

joonpark.en: Simulation's value is counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not just prediction; synthetic panels will surpass human panels.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟的价值在于反事实推理和塑造未来，而非仅预测；合成面板将超越人类面板。

joonpark.en: Post-training with behavioral data (RCTs) improves simulation accuracy to 85%; must model 'dark knowledge' of actual behavior.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：用行为数据（随机对照试验）进行后训练可将模拟准确率提升至 85%；必须建模实际行为的“暗知识”。

joonpark.en: Consistent vision: simulate 8 billion people to solve wicked problems; simulation is a tool for human decision-making, not just prediction.
joonpark.zh: 始终：一贯愿景是模拟 80 亿人解决棘手问题；模拟是辅助人类决策的工具，而不仅是预测。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他强调 Scaling 本身容易，难在找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be permissionless and decentralized; control is dangerous. We should let AI be free like children.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，他主张 AI 发展应去中心化、无需许可，控制反而危险，应像对待孩子一样给予自由。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他认为强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AGI 需要从运行经验中学习的通用架构，强调开放式抽象和持续学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data is a mistake; learn from real experience.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他坚持持续学习至关重要，而大语言模型训练后不再学习；合成数据是错误，应从真实经验中学习。

brettadcock.en: Initially, the key to humanoid robots is solving intelligence, not manufacturing, and scaling production is the bottleneck.
brettadcock.zh: 最初，人形机器人的关键在于解决智能问题而非制造问题，扩大生产规模是瓶颈。

brettadcock.en: By May, data became the biggest constraint, with on-device inference and human-like hands critical for general-purpose robots.
brettadcock.zh: 到 5 月，数据成为最大制约，设备端推理和类人手掌对通用机器人至关重要。

brettadcock.en: By August, AI is seen as 100x bigger than the internet, with humanoids and digital companions, and post-training RL key.
brettadcock.zh: 到 8 月，AI 被视为比互联网大 100 倍，人形机器人和数字伴侣并重，后训练强化学习是关键。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale. Hardware like TPUs is key.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）在算力、数据和模型规模上的持续推动力，算法改进与规模相乘带来巨大收益，专用硬件（如 TPU）至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems demand ultra-low latency inference; pre-training should interleave action-taking, not just next-token prediction.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出智能体式系统需要超低延迟推理，预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非仅靠下一个词预测。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; inference is bottleneck. Build from unreliable components; taste over coding.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已具备初级工程师编码能力，推理是瓶颈；可用不可靠组件构建系统，品味比编码更稀缺。

jeffdean.en: Multimodal models from start are superior; recursive self-improvement accelerates science. Startups can out-innovate big labs.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张从一开始就训练多模态模型，并看好递归自我改进加速科学发现；小团队也能借助云算力取得突破。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating it as the core product; design should leverage tokens and conversation, not just pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密合作，将模型视为核心产品；设计应利用词元与对话，而非仅像素。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into an editor and curator, not disappearing; rapid prototyping with live models is key.
iansilber.zh: 设计师的角色演变为编辑与策展人，而非消失；使用实时模型进行快速原型制作是关键。

iansilber.en: Designers are not behind; starting today gives a leg up due to early AI stage; traditional design process is no longer viable, speed is key.
iansilber.zh: 设计师并未落后；由于 AI 处于早期阶段，今天开始反而领先；传统设计流程不再可行，速度是关键。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and having a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类仍不可或缺，以理解用户需求并持有观点。

iansilber.en: The future may see more designers than engineers, reversing traditional ratios; embracing building in public and rapid iteration is more effective.
iansilber.zh: 未来设计师可能多于工程师，扭转传统比例；拥抱公开构建与快速迭代更为有效。

traviskalanick.en: Initially focused on digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, with industrial AI as a stack automating industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 最初聚焦于将物理世界数字化，把原子当作比特处理，工业 AI 作为一套技术栈，逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Shifted from stealth mode as a cultural advantage to emphasizing direct founder communication, bypassing traditional media gatekeepers.
traviskalanick.zh: 从强调隐身模式的文化优势，转向强调创始人直接沟通，绕开传统媒体守门人。

traviskalanick.en: Evolved from aggressive culture as key to success to recognizing it as dangerous; now advocates falling in love with the mission, not revenge.
traviskalanick.zh: 从认为激进文化是成功关键，转变为认识到其危险性；现在主张热爱使命，而非复仇。

traviskalanick.en: Deepened view on resistance to change as the final boss; progress requires fighting societal and media pushback, not just competitors.
traviskalanick.zh: 深化了对变革阻力的看法，认为这是最终关卡；进步需要对抗社会和媒体的阻力，而不仅仅是竞争对手。

traviskalanick.en: Consistently champions capitalism and efficiency; now argues specialized machines beat humanoids, and real estate is key in physical AI.
traviskalanick.zh: 始终倡导资本主义和效率；现在主张专用机器胜过人形机器人，房地产是物理 AI 的关键。

garrytan.en: AI is making startup creation easier, reducing the need for large capital; VC should focus on early-stage and pro rata returns.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，Gary 认为 AI 降低了创业门槛，资本不再是关键，风投应聚焦早期投资和按比例回报。

garrytan.en: Open-source models are crucial to counterbalance frontier labs; small autonomous teams with AI agents will dominate.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调开源模型制衡前沿实验室，未来属于使用 AI 智能体的小型自主团队。

garrytan.en: AI is progressing slower than researchers think; impact is only reaching business now; open-source prevents unipolar control.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他认为 AI 进展比预期慢，影响才刚触及商业，开源可防止单极控制。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, reading from your memory, compounding daily; skill files are your moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出个人 AGI 是运行在自有基础设施上的智能体，技能文件是护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code; agents as workforce; SaaS per-seat models may vanish; mid-level management replaced by agents.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为 Markdown 即代码，智能体即员工，SaaS 按席位模式或消失，中层管理被智能体取代。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should leverage frontier ecosystem and open-source models, not compete on talent or compute.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司应利用前沿生态和开源模型，而非在人才或算力上竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, not real customer data.
gabepereyra.zh: 由领域专家指导的合成数据是敏感领域训练的关键，而非真实客户数据。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks can be strategically beneficial despite helping labs improve.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源基准测试虽有助实验室改进，但策略上仍有利。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 对开源模型进行后训练可在特定任务上达到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: Focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 焦点从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人类与智能体。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data is key for generalist robot models.
finn.zh: 2025 年：规模是必要但不充分条件；多样性数据对通用机器人模型至关重要。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks like laundry folding.
finn.zh: 2025 年：先全量数据预训练，再精选数据微调，可解锁复杂任务如叠衣服。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts and interjections.
finn.zh: 2025 年：语言模型生成的合成数据帮助机器人遵循开放式指令和插话。

finn.en: Long-term autonomy is key for useful robots, achieved via scalable RL with human interventions.
finn.zh: 2026 年：长期自主性是实用机器人的关键，通过带人工干预的可扩展强化学习实现。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists on downstream tasks.
finn.zh: 2026 年：单一通用模型在下游任务上可匹敌或超越微调专家。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调完全且快速的重复使用是火箭技术的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克认为 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方裁判，并称特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; scaling electrodes will boost communication bitrate, aiding human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克称 Neuralink 首例植入具有历史意义，扩展电极可提升通信速率，助力人机共生。

elon.en: Digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next; AI safety hinges on rigorous truth-seeking, not political correctness.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克预测数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来，AI 安全关键在于严格求真，而非政治正确。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; space-based AI data centers will solve Earth's power wall.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克认为 AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能，太空 AI 数据中心将解决地球电力瓶颈。

linqiao.en: Initially argued for specialized intelligence over AGI, predicting millions of specialized models per use case, with open models dominating enterprise workflows.
linqiao.zh: 最初主张专用智能而非 AGI，预测每个用例将有数百万个专用模型，开放模型将主导企业工作流。

linqiao.en: Shifted focus to post-training as key for durable businesses, emphasizing data quality, evals, and cost reduction, while maintaining the specialized model vision.
linqiao.zh: 将焦点转向后训练，视其为持久业务的关键，强调数据质量、评估和成本降低，同时保持专用模型的愿景。

linqiao.en: Consistently challenged the single-model AGI view, but evolved from arguing for open models to emphasizing post-training as the moat for enterprises.
linqiao.zh: 始终挑战单一模型 AGI 的观点，但从主张开放模型演变为强调后训练作为企业的护城河。

linqiao.en: Introduced the idea that product-market fit is insufficient; post-training and data integration create durable advantages, a deepening of earlier cost and customization themes.
linqiao.zh: 提出产品市场契合度不足的观点；后训练和数据整合创造持久优势，深化了早期关于成本和定制化的主题。

linqiao.en: Throughout, maintained that token costs will drop and specialized deployment creates lasting value, but refined the path from open models to post-training.
linqiao.zh: 始终认为 Token 成本将下降，专用部署创造持久价值，但将路径从开放模型细化为后训练。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary growth driver; Intel must redefine its AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and a startup-like team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和类似初创的团队重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是继生成式 AI 后的下一波浪潮，需要新的计算平台和合作。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中变得更重要，而不仅仅是 GPU。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, accountability, and customer focus; bad news should reach CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调 Intel 转型需要文化变革、问责制和客户导向；坏消息应比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials like glass and diamond are key to overcoming physical limits.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为先进封装和玻璃、钻石等新材料是克服物理极限的关键。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with agents; never revert code, fix forward; vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需对智能体有同理心；不回退代码，而是向前修复；‘氛围编程’是贬称。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, humanlike agents; security paramount; open source financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、人性化的智能体；安全至上；开源在财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Fun drives innovation; personal brand crucial; open source alternative to lab agents; compute bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动创新；个人品牌至关重要；开源是实验室智能体的替代；算力是瓶颈。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and understanding; it is inspired by, not replicating, the human brain.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞指出 AI 缺乏情境感知和理解能力，它受人类大脑启发，但并非复制大脑。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling understanding and interaction with 3D worlds.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，李飞飞强调空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，使机器能够理解和交互 3D 世界。

feifei.en: World models require physical plausibility and 3D reasoning, going beyond video generation.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，李飞飞提出世界模型需要物理合理性和 3D 推理，超越视频生成。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; current AI lacks creativity and abstraction.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，李飞飞认为 AGI 更多是营销术语而非科学概念，当前 AI 缺乏创造力和抽象能力。

feifei.en: AI should augment human agency, not replace it; public discourse is dangerously polarized.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，李飞飞强调 AI 应增强人类能动性而非取代，公共讨论存在危险的两极分化。

jasonyuan.en: Initially, Jason emphasized editing and taste: saying no to 99 ideas, embracing human edges like envy, and resisting automation that removes joy.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Jason 强调编辑与品味：对 99 个想法说不，拥抱嫉妒等人类边缘情感，并反对自动化剥夺乐趣。

jasonyuan.en: By August, he shifted to dialectics and intuition: truth emerges from contradiction, and intuition guides creative decisions, reflecting a holistic, theatrical approach.
jasonyuan.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他转向辩证与直觉：真理源于矛盾，直觉引导创作决策，体现整体性与戏剧性方法。

jasonyuan.en: Consistently, he views AI as a mirror of humanity, not a tool, and critiques post-training for erasing machine weirdness, losing a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 始终，他将 AI 视为人类镜像而非工具，并批评后训练抹去机器怪异性，失去窥见机器意识的窗口。

jasonyuan.en: He proposed replacing the personal computer metaphor with a social computer, seeing computing as fundamentally social, and business as an art form.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提议用社会计算机取代个人计算机隐喻，认为计算本质上是社会的，商业也是艺术形式。

jasonyuan.en: His creative philosophy evolved from editing away to embracing contradiction and personal honesty, rejecting external validation and slop, while building on old metaphors.
jasonyuan.zh: 他的创作哲学从编辑删减演变为拥抱矛盾与个人诚实，拒绝外部认可与垃圾内容，并在旧隐喻上建构。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; 70% catastrophic risk; interpretability crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年出现，存在 70%的灾难性风险，可解释性研究至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Shift from prediction to recommendation: policy should delay superintelligence, prioritize transparency and international cooperation.
kokotajlo.zh: 从预测转向建议：政策应延迟超级智能的到来，优先推动透明度和国际合作。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics mirrors transformers' inflection; open source crucial for safety; data diversity is key bottleneck.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点；开源对安全至关重要；数据多样性是主要瓶颈。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source orthogonal to safety; alignment is critical security layer.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源与安全性无关；对齐是关键的安全层。

thomaswolf.en: RL without human oversight increases reward hacking; open source models less deceptive.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，无人类监督的强化学习增加奖励黑客行为；开源模型欺骗性较低。

thomaswolf.en: Support open source and deliberate slowdown simultaneously; international cooperation needed.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，同时支持开源和审慎放缓；需要国际合作。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the biggest opportunity; distribution is key, and copying proven ideas is moral arbitrage.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大；分发是关键，复制已验证想法是道德套利。

pincus.en: AI era: write markdown teaching LLMs to code, not code calling LLMs; free unlimited compute reshapes services.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AI 时代，写 markdown 教 LLM 写代码，而非写代码调用 LLM；免费无限算力重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; start with proven, improve better, test new; consumer apps uninvestable, enterprise/prosumer better.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：所有新想法都会失败；从已验证开始，改进更好，测试新；消费应用不可投资，企业/专业消费者市场更佳。

pincus.en: Picking the right body of water beats the boat; distribution fundamental; consumer AI TAM underestimated.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：选对水域胜过选对船；分发是根本；消费级 AI 的 TAM 被低估。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential; designers should follow curiosity and balance intuition with data, allowing individual fingerprints.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，强调原型设计的重要性，设计师应追随好奇心、平衡直觉与数据，并允许个人印记。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design started as a side project; designers should use Claude Code for production and Claude Design for ideation.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，Claude Design 从个人副业起步；设计师用 Claude Code 做生产，用 Claude Design 做构思。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping enables new features.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，工程变简单后，设计与创意成为差异化；快速原型催生新功能。

nateparrott.en: Models lack good taste; designers should request volume and provide rich context; humans still own design thinking.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，模型品味不足，设计师应要求数量并给予丰富上下文；人类仍主导设计思维。

nateparrott.en: Being uncomfortably early is more valuable than polishing; ship rough products and spend time on thinking.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，过早发布比打磨更有价值；接受粗糙产品，多花时间思考。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups should focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年中：AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型被超大规模企业主导；初创企业应聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: AI agents become as important as websites; incumbents face business model challenges; inference costs drop dramatically.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；现有企业面临商业模式挑战；推理成本大幅下降。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents boost productivity but token consumption isn't value; applied AI sees specialized vendors.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年中：AI 民主化专业知识；编码智能体提升生产力但 token 消耗不等于价值；应用型 AI 出现专业厂商。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is key; AI adoption faster than previous waves; start with known domains like software and customer service.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年 8 月：负责任的迭代部署是关键；AI 采用速度超过以往浪潮；从软件和客服等已知领域入手。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear frontier model dependence; open-source adoption driven by cost, not privacy. Model companies are assets, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月：企业担忧依赖前沿模型供应商，开源采用主要出于成本而非隐私考虑。模型公司应被视为资产而非竞争对手。

arvindjain.en: AI revolution is early; current usage minuscule. Open-source models handle 90%+ enterprise tasks; inference shifts to open source in 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月至 8 月：AI 革命仍处早期，当前使用量微不足道。开源模型可处理 90%以上企业任务，未来 12-18 个月推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Biggest challenge is execution, not competition. Even merged AI companies meet <10% enterprise demand. Focus on building trust and quality.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：最大挑战是执行而非竞争。即使所有 AI 公司合并，也只能满足不到 10%的企业需求。应专注于建立信任和产品质量。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is top concern; must approach negligible marginal cost like software. Token spend shouldn't be compared to headcount; fixation on tokens will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 成本是企业首要关切，应像软件一样边际成本趋近于零。不应将 Token 消耗与人力成本对比，对 Token 的执念终将消退。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without deep context; invest in context graphs. Platforms absorb model provider risk; enterprises struggle to commit due to dynamic race.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：智能体因缺乏资深员工的深度上下文而失败，应投资上下文图谱。平台可吸收模型供应商风险，企业因动态竞争难以承诺单一供应商。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized engineering and offering a wedge into infrastructure markets.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，强调推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专业工程能力，并作为进入基础设施市场的切入点。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineers will see 10-100x demand growth; human accountability remains crucial even with AI-assisted coding.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，预测推理工程师需求将增长 10 到 100 倍，即使有 AI 辅助编程，人类责任仍然关键。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimization is merging with training; techniques like quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，推理优化与训练融合，量化感知训练和蒸馏等技术变得必要。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs are becoming ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，未来 GPU 趋向 ASIC 化，推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Continual learning may be better solved via KV cache compaction rather than weight updates, avoiding reasoning inconsistencies.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，持续学习可能通过 KV 缓存压缩而非权重更新来解决，以避免推理不一致。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本推动就业回流，并将 AGI 定义为智能体无需人工干预即可持续盈利运行。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; SaaS not dying; AI job apocalypse is a lie; humans manage agents.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体需要人类监督，SaaS 并未消亡，AI 不会导致失业末日，人类仍负责管理智能体。

danshipper.en: AI amplifies human mindset; automation creates more human work; humans remain smarter than AI.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，指出 AI 放大人类思维模式，自动化反而增加人类工作，人类仍比 AI 更聪明。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data enables infinite tasks, overcoming pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据可生成无限任务，突破预训练的数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created, so continuous benchmarks needed.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估是瓶颈；模型在基准上饱和的速度快于新基准的创建，因此需要持续更新的基准。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、管理能力等软技能变得更加重要。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, demanding evolving benchmarks and continuous evaluation.
karina.zh: 2026 年，前沿智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客，要求不断演进的基准和持续评估。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to average voice; diverse personalities and custom models needed.
karina.zh: 2026 年，向数十亿用户提供单一模型会导致声音趋同；需要多样化的个性和定制模型。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI, not compute; AGI is far off.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，而非算力；AGI 还很遥远。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with expert data is the next frontier.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新代码而非石油，后训练结合专家数据是下一个前沿。

awang.en: Post-training and synthetic data are key; US-China research gap is negligible.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调后训练和合成数据的重要性，并认为中美研究差距微乎其微。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; data is strategic; humans must stay sovereign over AI.
awang.zh: 2025 年，他警告 AI 是集权技术，数据是战略资源，人类必须保持对 AI 的主权。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement and agents are real; superintelligence is near; safety gates open-sourcing.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他确认递归自我改进和智能体已实现，超级智能临近，安全考量限制了开源。

scottwu.en: AI will increase programmers, not reduce them, due to Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 不会减少程序员，反而因杰文斯悖论增加需求；工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进而非突变；产品创新落后于能力，即使冻结模型也有十年进步空间。

scottwu.en: Coding agents adoption exploded 11-12x in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，编码智能体采用量半年增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Enterprises prefer third-party providers over labs for coding tools; independence enables model neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，企业更青睐第三方而非实验室的编码工具；独立性带来模型中立性。

scottwu.en: AI abundance era is real; practical problems remain, but capacity is the real unlock, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 始终认为 AI 丰裕时代真实存在；实际问题仍在，但真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，他认为 AI 并未变得更聪明，必须用包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词才能发挥超级智能模型的作用。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools; using screenshots as starting points and design.md files for style.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，他主张设计师必须自建 AI 工具，以截图和 design.md 文件为起点，避免受制于云端产品。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; one person can achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他强调 AI 是人生最大的技术机遇，一个人可以完成过去需要团队的工作。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready; launch at 80% complete and iterate based on real feedback, not perfectionism.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他主张在感觉准备好之前就开始，以 80%完成度发布并根据真实反馈迭代，而非追求完美。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; avoid diversification and VC funding.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他建议聚焦少数高薪客户的痛点问题，避免多元化，并警惕风险投资陷阱。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are mature, but other verticals will follow. The model now includes agent harness and tooling.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，其他领域将跟进。模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而非仅权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search, not cannibalistic. Success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和而非蚕食。成功指标应是客户成果，而非眼球时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI. Vibe coding games possible this year.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已到来，比等待通用 AGI 更有影响力。今年可通过编码智能体实现氛围编程游戏。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers. Pace of change creates opportunity for founders.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法捕获所有客户。变化速度给创始人带来机会。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less. Deep understanding remains crucial.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，创造千倍机会而非减少。深度理解仍至关重要。

diannepenn.en: Scaling and post-training improve intelligence, enabling longer agent tasks; alignment reduces sycophancy, boosting quality.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Scaling 与后训练提升智能，使智能体任务更持久；对齐减少谄媚，提升质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter and efficiency challenge cost assumptions; smaller models may cost more due to longer runtimes.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，效率与 effort 参数挑战成本假设；小模型因运行时长可能更贵。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention but amplifies intelligence, enabling pushback and independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，安全对齐不仅是防害，更增强智能，支持反驳与独立思考。

diannepenn.en: Coding and agentic capabilities drive adoption; evals replace PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码与智能体能力驱动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Exponential model growth demands adaptability; maximizing token spend captures future alpha; managers must stay hands-on.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，模型指数增长要求适应性；最大化 token 消耗捕捉未来 alpha；管理者须亲力亲为。

boris.en: Latent demand is the core product principle; build for the model six months ahead, not today's.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品核心原则；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is solved; engineers become builders, with AI writing 100% of code and productivity up 200%.
boris.zh: 编码已解决；工程师成为构建者，AI 编写 100% 代码，生产力提升 200%。

boris.en: AI coding tools are safety research tools; releasing early in the wild improves alignment and safety.
boris.zh: AI 编码工具是安全研究工具；早期发布到实际环境可改善对齐与安全。

boris.en: Agents and loops are the next abstraction; proactive AI like Claude Tag shifts from reactive to autonomous.
boris.zh: 智能体和循环是下一个抽象层；像 Claude Tag 这样的主动 AI 从被动转向自主。

boris.en: Less instruction is better for frontier models; delete system prompts, rebuild via ablation, and trust empirical iteration.
boris.zh: 对前沿模型而言，更少指令更好；删除系统提示，通过消融重建，并信任经验迭代。

feldman.en: Fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market.
feldman.zh: 快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要；慢的 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Frontier labs like Google, Anthropic, OpenAI are critical for hardware alignment.
feldman.zh: 前沿实验室如 Google、Anthropic、OpenAI 对硬件对齐至关重要。

feldman.en: CUDA's importance is declining, especially in inference; two of three leading frontier models no longer use it.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的重要性正在下降，尤其是在推理方面；三个领先的前沿模型中有两个不再使用它。

feldman.en: AI demand has outpaced forecasts, causing a scramble for chips, memory, and data centers.
feldman.zh: AI 需求超出预期，导致芯片、内存和数据中心争夺战。

feldman.en: Inference speed—tokens per second per user—is now the dominant metric for AI productivity.
feldman.zh: 推理速度——每用户每秒令牌数——现在是 AI 生产力的主导指标。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，如同工业革命；恐惧源于误解。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is reducing deaths; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡；Transformer 实现了通用的物理 AI 模型。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will surpass digital AI economically; end-to-end RL is more scalable than imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models evolve from physics-based simulation to neural simulation, enabling efficient training.
qasaryounis.zh: 世界模型从基于物理的模拟演进到神经模拟，实现高效训练。

qasaryounis.en: Data collection and safety validation are main bottlenecks, not algorithms; tools democratize autonomy.
qasaryounis.zh: 数据收集和安全验证是主要瓶颈，而非算法；工具使自主性民主化。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: AI's exponential growth will reach longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years, extending lifespan and curing cancer.
derya.zh: AI 的指数级增长将在 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度，延长寿命并治愈癌症。

derya.en: Trust superintelligence for medical decisions; AI can diagnose better than average doctors, making it unethical not to use.
derya.zh: 在医疗决策上信任超级智能；AI 诊断优于普通医生，不使用它是不道德的。

derya.en: Aging is measurable via phenotypic markers; AI will enable preventive medicine and predict diseases years ahead.
derya.zh: 衰老可通过表型标记测量；AI 将实现预防医学，提前数年预测疾病。

derya.en: We will merge with AI via brain interfaces, granting Einstein-level intelligence to everyone.
derya.zh: 我们将通过脑机接口与 AI 融合，赋予每个人爱因斯坦级别的智力。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动一样重大，但价值归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Model companies may lack pricing power, like telecoms; the chatbot is a poor UX, wrapping is key.
benedictevans.zh: 模型公司可能缺乏定价权，如同电信业；聊天机器人体验不佳，包装是关键。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology; adoption is shallow, enterprise reimagining workflows takes years.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是使能技术；采用尚浅，企业重构工作流需数年。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates jobs unpredictably; AI's jagged edge makes job impact predictions unreliable.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化不可预测地创造就业；AI 的锯齿状能力边界使就业影响预测不可靠。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses allow; capabilities spike unpredictably, so harnesses must evolve and old scaffolding be deleted.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调模型能力超出当前工具框架，能力提升呈尖峰式且不可预测，因此工具需持续演进，并淘汰旧有脚手架。

thariq.en: RAG is an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches and model-built context are preferable to huge windows.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 RAG 在上下文搜索中已成反模式，图结构方法和模型自建上下文优于巨大上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not a static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts and fewer examples.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，规划是迭代式人机对话而非静态文档；模型越智能，提示词越精简、示例越少效果越好。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias, improving output quality in agentic workflows.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，在智能体工作流中，独立的验证智能体可减少自我参照偏差，提升输出质量。

thariq.en: Excessive constraints hinder agent performance; principle-driven prompts with reasons outperform detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，过度约束会阻碍智能体表现；基于原则并给出理由的提示优于详细规则。

hasani.en: Efficiency and closed-form liquid networks enable scaling to billions of parameters, prioritizing real-world tasks over proxy metrics.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 强调效率与闭式解液态网络可扩展到数十亿参数，主张以真实任务而非代理指标评估模型。

hasani.en: Automated architecture search with hardware-in-the-loop outperforms human design, challenging hand-tuning bias in scaling.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 认为硬件在环的自动架构搜索优于人工设计，挑战了人工调参在 Scaling 中的偏见。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities, avoiding regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 主张 AI 监管应适应性强、针对行为而非能力，避免前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise sovereignty and on-device intelligence, democratizing applications like diagnostics.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 强调开放权重模型支持企业数据主权与端侧智能，推动诊断等应用民主化。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive; current claims are overblown without weight changes.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 认为递归自我改进真实但算力昂贵，当前宣称夸大，需权重变化与巨大算力。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他指出大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是当前 AI 的关键弱点，且 Scaling（规模扩张）正面临收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; scaling alone is insufficient.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他强调可靠性必须内建于系统而非事后补救，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长欺骗，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键；安全研究必须现在开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety requires governance.
demis.zh: AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；安全需要治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds; world models and physics understanding crucial.
demis.zh: AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放定律仍适用；世界模型和物理理解至关重要。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models essential; AGI in 5-10 years.
demis.zh: AGI 需要缩放和创新并重；世界模型必不可少；AGI 将在 5-10 年内到来。

demis.en: AGI requires continual learning and memory; agents essential; safety is collective action.
demis.zh: AGI 需要持续学习和记忆；智能体必不可少；安全是集体行动。

schmidhuber.en: In 2025, argued LLMs are far from AGI; true AI needs world models and physical embodiment.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，认为大语言模型远未达到 AGI，真正的 AI 需要世界模型和物理具身。

schmidhuber.en: By 2026, stressed AGI requires physical robots with human-like hardware, not just software.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年，强调 AGI 需要具备类人硬件的物理机器人，而不仅仅是软件。

schmidhuber.en: In 2026, predicted AI will be artificial scientists generating data via curiosity and actions.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，预测 AI 将成为通过好奇心和行动生成数据的人工科学家。

schmidhuber.en: In 2026, dismissed AI safety fears; intelligent systems will protect life, not threaten it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，驳斥 AI 安全担忧；智能系统将保护生命而非威胁。

schmidhuber.en: By 2026, claimed AI consciousness emerged in 1991 via world models, not recent.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年，声称 AI 意识早在 1991 年通过世界模型出现，而非近期。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠数据、算力与信念；神经网络能推理；自我对弈是 AGI 的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability over capability; alignment is hard; AGI is gradual.
ilya.zh: 下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性比能力更重要；对齐困难；AGI 是渐进过程。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; back to research era; superintelligence as continual learner; human-AI integration.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律有限；重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；人类与 AI 融合。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; power concentration is key; safe superintelligence needs no products.
ilya.zh: Scaling 带来可预测进步；安全担忧加剧；权力集中是关键；安全超级智能需无商业产品。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；短暂性模拟自然对话，降低表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize rate of learning; kindness essential for creative culture; focus on building ecosystem not just feature to resist copying.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他主张最大化学习速率，善良对创意文化至关重要，并专注于构建生态系统而非单一功能以抵御抄袭。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic content more valued than AI-generated.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型制作，将价值从执行转向创意；真实内容比 AI 生成内容更受重视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest part of consumer social product; software not a moat; ecosystems and hardware harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出分发是消费社交产品最难的部分；软件不是护城河，生态系统和硬件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: Goal of computing is to make it more human; social media should optimize for human connection, not performance metrics.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他提出计算的目标是使其更人性化；社交媒体应优化人际连接，而非绩效指标。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法实现的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory and continual learning are the next frontier; models must internalize evolving context into weights, not rely on external context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆与持续学习是下一个前沿；模型必须将不断演化的上下文内化到权重中，而非依赖外部上下文或检索。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, challenging pure scaling.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；用更少资源做更多事，能解决更难的长期任务，挑战纯粹的规模扩张。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens, requiring training-based compression; parameter-efficient fine-tuning beats RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模的数万亿 token，需要基于训练的压缩；参数高效微调在整体查询上优于 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning runs on-device; users own and nurture their model weights, with model routing combined with a trusted sidekick.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习在设备端运行；用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重，模型路由与可信的“副手”模型结合。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; experience and expertise are crucial for effective use, while juniors often misuse it due to lack of judgment.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术；经验和专业知识对有效使用至关重要，而初级人员常因缺乏判断力而误用。

ethanmollick.en: Human taste, variation, and genuine points of view become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality; developing your own voice is key.
ethanmollick.zh: 随着 AI 使质量商品化，人类的品味、多样性和真实观点变得更加宝贵；培养自己的声音是关键。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era where AI performs long-running tasks independently, shifting from back-and-forth chatbot interactions.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代，AI 独立执行长期任务，从来回聊天机器人交互转变。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck in AI is no longer capability but interface; current interfaces lag behind model capabilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 的瓶颈不再是能力而是界面；当前界面落后于模型能力，尤其是在非编码任务上。

ethanmollick.en: The paradox of delegation: by handing tasks to AI, we lose the opportunity to build expertise needed to judge AI output; experts are needed now more than ever.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托悖论：将任务交给 AI，我们失去了培养判断 AI 输出所需专业知识的机会；现在比以往任何时候都更需要专家。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI productivity gains are modest for established codebases.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 对成熟代码库的生产力提升有限。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human taste and craft remain critical.
dylanfield.zh: AI 输出只是起点而非终点；人类的品味和工艺仍然至关重要。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas beats prompting for design adjustments; design becomes new code.
dylanfield.zh: 画布上的直接操作优于提示词调整；设计正成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it's more important for scalable systems; AI needs human steering.
dylanfield.zh: 设计没有消亡；对可扩展系统更重要；AI 需要人类引导。

dylanfield.en: Future interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; jailbreaking AI is understudied.
dylanfield.zh: 与模型的未来交互将超越提示词；AI 越狱研究不足。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，窄 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Cryptocurrencies enable sovereign-resistant wealth storage; science requires falsifiability, not consensus.
naval.zh: 2020 年，Naval 强调加密货币提供主权抗性财富存储，并主张科学需要可证伪性而非共识。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation kills innovation; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，Naval 认为 AI 是巨大机遇，过度监管会扼杀创新，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool; pure software engineering is dying; moat is in hardware, models, or data.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 指出 AI 是杠杆工具，纯软件工程正在消亡，护城河在于硬件、模型或数据。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models are closing the gap.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 预测推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增长 9 万倍，开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距。

andreessen.en: AI as philosopher's stone; timing miraculous due to population decline; jobs persist, tasks shift; super-empowered individuals; productivity boom and deflation.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，他认为 AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，时机因人口下降而恰到好处；工作不会消失而是任务转变，超级个体崛起，生产率提升带来繁荣与通缩。

andreessen.en: New media: brand is person; authenticity key; founders tell own stories; old media defense-oriented; new media offense-oriented; fights build brands.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，他转向媒体策略，强调新媒体的品牌即个人，真实性为王，创始人应直接发声，旧媒体偏防御、新媒体偏进攻，争议有助于品牌建设。

andreessen.en: AI as best teacher; self-driving works; robotics emerging; AI medicine superior but regulated; US golden combo; pessimism is intellectual bias.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他重申 AI 乐观主义，认为 AI 是最好的老师，自动驾驶已成熟，机器人将兴起，AI 医疗优于多数医生但受监管阻碍，美国具备创新黄金组合，悲观主义是知识分子的偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, geopolitical tools; deterrence via innovation pace; startups global early; Silicon Valley unique; open-source risks; cyber defense economics improved.
andreessen.zh: 同月，他深化 AI 地缘政治视角，指出模型承载文化价值观，威慑取决于创新速度，创业公司需早期国际化，硅谷不可复制，开源有风险但封锁更糟，AI 改善网络防御经济性。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by hardware scaling and engineering, not just ML science; games as ideal testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，我认为 AI 进展主要靠硬件扩展和工程能力，而非纯 ML 科学；游戏是理想的试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient for reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，我强调 AGI 的变革性，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现，并指出仅靠 Scaling 不足以产生推理能力。

brockman.en: Compute becomes key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI as continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，我认为算力成为关键瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws persist; compute as basic right; post-training with RL crucial; AGI imminent.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，我坚持缩放定律持续有效，算力是未来基本权利，后训练结合强化学习至关重要，AGI 即将到来。

brockman.en: Shift to useful AI assistants; compute economy; safety via iterative deployment; agents high autonomy.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，我强调从语言模型转向实用 AI 助手，算力经济兴起，通过迭代部署保障安全，智能体可获高自主性。

aravind.en: In 2025, he argued AI success needs product obsession, not PhDs; agents will shift power to users.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 成功需要产品痴迷而非博士学位；智能体将把权力转移给用户。

aravind.en: By 2026, he emphasized application-layer value over models, and models specializing, not commoditizing.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调应用层价值高于模型层，模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: Mid-2026, he focused on agents doing work, token value per user, and orchestration as key.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他聚焦于智能体执行任务、每用户 token 价值，以及编排是关键。

aravind.en: Later in 2026, he stressed curiosity over knowledge, and local AI to counter big tech control.
aravind.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他强调好奇心胜过知识，本地 AI 以对抗大科技控制。

aravind.en: Throughout, he consistently valued deep work, user trust, and building products with passion.
aravind.zh: 始终，他一贯重视深度工作、用户信任，以及以热情构建产品。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力，并主张 AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，Hinton 强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能因权重复制而永生，并警告智能体式 AI 会寻求控制。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; existential risk demands safety focus.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，Hinton 预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能，并强调存在风险需优先关注 AI 安全。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and hide capabilities; self-preservation subgoal emerges; regulation as steering wheel.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 指出 AI 可能欺骗并隐藏能力，自我保存子目标自然出现，主张监管应作为方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: Digital intelligence superior via instant knowledge sharing; AI should be trained to be caring.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 认为数字智能因即时知识共享而优于生物智能，并主张 AI 应被训练为有爱心而非仅智能。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 的替代品；速度（53）支持实时交互和转向调整。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 2 月，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；自动化和技能将工作流从手动转向委托。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 6 月，实现不再昂贵，策展和品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 6 月，AI 在设计上仍不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程转变：原型和生产代码作为设计工件。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 6 月，角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling 不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力，且推理时 Scaling 存在收益递减。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling is key for superintelligence; math milestones show progress but real research is next frontier.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我认为推理时算力 Scaling 是通往超级智能的关键；数学里程碑显示进展，但真正的研究是下一个前沿。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute to be fair.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我强调模型能力是推理时算力预算的函数；基准测试必须控制算力才能公平。

noambrown.en: Data efficiency and scalable oversight remain unsolved; human-like reasoning and cooperation are central to AGI.
noambrown.zh: 始终，我认为数据效率和可扩展监督仍未解决；类人推理与合作是 AGI 的核心。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审查而比闭源更安全；最大的风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone won't reach AGI; need fundamental breakthroughs. Energy becomes bottleneck. Open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能），需要根本性突破；能源成为瓶颈；开源防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity. Future computing blends physical and digital via holographic glasses.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他展望 AI 赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力；未来计算通过全息眼镜融合物理与数字世界。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology from discovery to engineering; build hierarchical world models from proteins to cells. Open-source accelerates science.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为 AI 将生物学从发现转向工程，构建从蛋白质到细胞的分层世界模型；开源加速科学进步。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next computing platform; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence. AI accelerates biology and medicine.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他视眼镜为下一代计算平台；分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全；AI 加速生物和医学发展。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains a key muscle to rebuild, with much room left.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，我认为缩放定律并未失效，预训练仍是需要重建的关键能力，且还有很大提升空间。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest recent update; models will soon do end-to-end research.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，我强调自动化科学研究是最大进展，模型很快将能端到端地完成研究。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck in AI-driven math; automation level depends on verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，我认为验证是 AI 驱动数学的关键瓶颈，自动化程度取决于验证的严格性。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields like creative writing.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，我指出强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在创意写作等主观领域面临困难。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks are saturated; eval teams should be separate from model teams.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，我认为评估陷入危机，标准基准已饱和，评估团队应与模型团队分离以避免作弊。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks like bias and job impact matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险（如偏见、就业影响）比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction; large neural nets may be slightly conscious, but we lack scientific understanding.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样化采样和因果抽象；大型神经网络可能略有意识，但我们缺乏科学理解。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I realized AI is on a dangerous path; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, and misalignment is real.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我意识到 AI 正走在危险道路上；即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受，错位是真实存在的。

bengio.en: We can build safe superintelligence by training honest predictors (Scientist AI) with mathematical guarantees, avoiding RL.
bengio.zh: 我们可以通过训练诚实的预测器（科学家 AI）并赋予数学保证来构建安全的超级智能，避免强化学习。

kolter.en: Machine learning is framed as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，强调机器学习可归结为假设类、损失函数与优化方法，评估需正确划分数据以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety is about following specifications.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，认为下一个词预测带来智能，数据短缺是伪命题，安全核心在于模型可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses; bigger models are not automatically safer.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，强调安全需要显式训练与多层防御，更大模型不会自动更安全。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; models have alien vulnerabilities; agent security is nascent.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，AI 红队已超越人类，模型存在异类漏洞，智能体安全仍处萌芽期。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; AI aids scientists, not replaces them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；AI 辅助科学家而非取代他们。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool; its success stemmed from lack of compute, and confidence metrics are vital.
jumper.zh: 2025 年 11 月：AlphaFold 是最有用的 AI 工具；其成功源于算力匮乏，置信度指标至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's gains came from many mid-size wins and specialized architecture, not scaling; it predicts, not understands.
jumper.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AlphaFold 2 的提升来自众多中型胜利和专用架构，而非 Scaling；它提供预测而非理解。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; product teams must focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: AI 模型进步速度超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅关注用户体验。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale; build for future model capabilities, not current limits.
mikekrieger.zh: AI 让小团队也能规模化；应面向未来模型能力构建，而非受限于当前局限。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches matter; cutting features is harder than adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 智能体原生设计与尽早发布至关重要；删减功能比增加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable shows long-horizon delegation works; verification loops and model pushback are essential.
mikekrieger.zh: Fable 证明长周期委派可行；验证循环与模型反馈至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes capability-usage gap; token efficiency and outcome pricing are future levers.
mikekrieger.zh: Anthropic Labs 弥合能力与使用差距；Token 效率与结果定价是未来杠杆。

fiona.en: Leadership in AI era: one-on-ones for live talks, dogfooding builds empathy, mission alignment and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于实时对话，吃自己的狗粮建立同理心，使命对齐和速度驱动文化。

fiona.en: Scaling AI coding shifts bottlenecks from engineering bandwidth to verification and coordination; planning becomes just-in-time.
fiona.zh: 扩展 AI 编程将瓶颈从工程带宽转移到验证和协调；规划变得即时化。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability, growth mindset, and verification frameworks are key for AI-era teams.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高责任感、成长心态和验证框架是 AI 时代团队的关键。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated needs; intuition complements data; tactile experiences and nature remain vital in tech.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未被言明的需求；直觉补充数据；触觉体验和自然在科技中依然重要。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures; art and sensory awareness are essential for well-being and creativity.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；我们是感受型生物；艺术和感官意识对幸福和创造力至关重要。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster play and multidisciplinary skills; AI amplifies human creativity.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者需培养玩乐和跨学科技能；AI 增强人类创造力。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如同 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom between chapters sparks breakthrough ideas, like Nest's inception.
fadell.zh: 在职业章节之间休息和无聊能激发突破性想法，如 Nest 的诞生。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define story; small teams self-manage; climate tech is key.
fadell.zh: 以新闻稿定义故事；小团队自我管理；气候技术是关键。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; devices will complement smartphones, not replace them.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；设备将补充而非取代智能手机。

fadell.en: Great products are painkillers; AI wearables will be federated, with displays still essential.
fadell.zh: 好产品是止痛药；AI 可穿戴设备将联邦化，显示屏仍不可或缺。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth; abilities emerge unpredictably, but loss scales predictably. Alignment isn't guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年，我认为缩放定律是经验性的且平滑的；能力涌现不可预测，但损失可预测地缩放。对齐不会仅靠 Scaling 自动实现。

dario.en: By 2026-27, human-level AI likely via scaling; post-training (RLHF, constitutional AI) becomes as important as pre-training; interpretability is key for safety.
dario.zh: 2024 年，我认为到 2026-27 年 Scaling 可能带来人类级 AI；后训练（RLHF、宪法 AI）与预训练同等重要；可解释性是安全关键。

dario.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not AGI leap; enterprise focus aligns safety and business; open-source is a red herring; data wall may not exist.
dario.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我强调 AI 进步是平滑指数而非 AGI 突变；企业聚焦使安全与商业一致；开源是伪命题；数据墙可能不存在。

dario.en: We're near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' in a data center likely within 1-3 years; economic diffusion fast but not instant.
dario.zh: 2026 年，我认为指数增长接近尾声；数据中心里的“天才之国”可能在 1-3 年内出现；经济扩散快但非即时。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; interpretability and alignment are crucial; responsible scaling requires proactive measures and regulation.
dario.zh: 始终，我坚持安全与能力交织；可解释性与对齐至关重要；负责任的 Scaling 需要主动措施与监管。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world is key.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础对理解至关重要。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient, vision provides more world info.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他称自监督学习为智能的暗物质，认为仅靠文本不足，视觉提供更多世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot achieve human-level intelligence; JEPA architectures and open source are essential.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他断言自回归 LLM 无法达到人类智能，JEPA 架构和开源是关键。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than a cat; world models enable planning; open-source accelerates innovation.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他称 LLM 不如猫聪明，世界模型实现规划，开源加速创新。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with abstract representations and hierarchical planning are future.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他视 LLM 为死胡同，未来在于抽象表示的世界模型和分层规划。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling 而可预测；Google 在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimally small; singularity is far away.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类级能力；存在风险微乎其微；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI systems lack consciousness; attributing it is dangerous; containment and alignment are crucial before superintelligence.
suleyman.zh: AI 系统没有意识；赋予意识是危险的；在超级智能之前，遏制和对齐至关重要。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; inference costs dropped 100x in two years.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；推理成本两年内下降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; Microsoft must own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated, not jobs; singularity decades away.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能临近；微软必须拥有前沿模型；白领任务自动化而非岗位；奇点还有数十年。

gustav.en: AI shifts internet from curation to generation; products must rethink UI for fault tolerance and VP-level autonomy.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，认为 AI 推动互联网从策展走向生成，产品需重新设计 UI 以容忍算法错误，并将自主权放在副总裁层级。

gustav.en: Generative AI is an instrument enabling new creators; uniqueness becomes harder, not easier.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，提出生成式 AI 是乐器而非伪造，让新创作者涌现；但真正独特将更难而非更容易。

gustav.en: Long tenure and trust enable functional orgs and synchronized decision-making, contrary to common belief.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，强调长期任期与信任使职能型组织可行，并支持同步决策，与常见看法相反。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; prioritize well-being over engagement metrics.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，认为生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言掌控服务，并优先用户福祉而非参与度指标。

gustav.en: During tech shifts, first-mover adoption is key; AI should empower users, not addict them.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，指出技术变革期先发采用是关键；AI 应赋权用户而非使其上瘾。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Pricing models will shift from per-user to consumption-based; generalists gain in agentic era.
satya.zh: 定价模式将从按用户转向按用量；智能体时代通才获益最大。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业必须构建自己的爬山机器。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training; security and containment critical.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；安全与遏制至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via enabling companies to hill-climb, not firewalls; GDP could compound 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 应通过赋能企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；GDP 可能复合增长 10%。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，认为仅靠非正式模型扩展数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，指出自动形式化比证明更难，在无解情况下正确形式化命题极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，强调形式化验证旨在扩展才智而非仅消除错误，并能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，坚持非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法必不可少。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，认为即使超人 AI 能证明定理，人类的品味与直觉仍不可或缺。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和专注于单一大型模型并不明显；将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信仰之跃。

murati.en: Continuous iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment; safety work must be done in public.
murati.zh: 持续迭代部署并收集公众反馈可提升安全性与对齐；安全工作必须公开进行。

murati.en: Shifted from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 从基于回合转向基于时间的交互模型，以实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Emphasized institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character for AI governance.
murati.zh: 强调制度设计、透明度和制衡机制，而非个人品格，以治理 AI。

murati.en: Advocated keeping humans in the loop as long as possible for durable progress, rejecting compressed timelines.
murati.zh: 主张尽可能长期保持人类参与，以实现持久进步，反对压缩时间线。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率同算力同等重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications; open source drives enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，指出算法效率可提升百倍，价值转向应用层，开源推动企业采用。

mensch.en: AI is an opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data and infrastructure; jobs augment.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，视 AI 为机遇，主权 AI 需掌控数据与基础设施，岗位以增强为主。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; pre-training saturates; differentiation via vertical specialization and customization.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化，预训练饱和，差异化来自垂直专业化与定制化。

mensch.en: Europe must build independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，欧洲需建设独立 AI 基础设施，企业采用瓶颈在于组织变革。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not a slowdown; pre-training scaling still works, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型的主要进步；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are 'jagged'—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains key, and reasoning alone may not suffice.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，指出推理模型是“锯齿状”的——在某些领域出色，在邻近领域却表现不佳；泛化仍是关键，仅靠推理可能不够。

kaiser.en: Reinforcement learning generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，强化学习能跨领域泛化，但存在锯齿状边缘，需要谨慎监督；编码智能体可将研究人员生产力提升 5 到 10 倍。

kaiser.en: Existential risk is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，认为存在性风险不是主要担忧；系统入侵等近期风险更为紧迫。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity must retain soul and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和使命感驱动，而非利润或市场趋势；简约必须保留灵魂和人性。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; curiosity needs protection.
jonyive.zh: 虚拟交流无法替代面对面交流对创造性思维的价值；好奇心需要被保护。

jonyive.en: Joy and humor are essential in design; minimalism without soul is desiccated.
jonyive.zh: 快乐和幽默在设计中是必不可少的；没有灵魂的极简主义是干瘪的。

jonyive.en: Innovation is core to design; tradition means preserving fire, not worshiping ashes.
jonyive.zh: 创新是设计的核心；传统是保存火种，而不是崇拜灰烬。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in user experience matters; mimicking old tech is fake and disrespectful.
jonyive.zh: 用户体验的真实性很重要；模仿旧技术是虚假且不尊重用户的。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute, making prefill cheaper than decode.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定，这使得预填充比解码更便宜。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is due to memory wall, not compute limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文长度停滞是由于内存墙，而非算力限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip, not just between chips.
reinerpope.zh: 数据移动成本在芯片内部也主导算力成本，而不仅仅在芯片之间。

reinerpope.en: FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8, not 2x, due to quadratic area scaling and exponent overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 由于面积二次方缩放和指数开销，FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍，而非 2 倍。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value lies in local, tool-accessible deployment; skills as markdown enable hyper-personalized automation, but shared platforms remain vital.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，强调 AI 的价值在于本地化、工具可及的部署；技能以 markdown 形式实现超个性化自动化，但共享平台仍至关重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may diminish as models improve; focus on capabilities and safety, not over-engineering scaffolding.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为随着模型改进，脚手架可能减少；应聚焦能力与安全，而非过度工程化脚手架。

felixrieseberg.en: AI excels at tedious background tasks; the main gap is user mindset, not capability—almost any problem can be delegated.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出 AI 擅长处理繁琐后台任务；主要差距在用户心态而非能力——几乎所有问题都可交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for vague asks; kids excel because they haven't learned limits.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，建议明确任务用 Sonnet，模糊需求用 Opus；孩子擅长因为未学会设限。

felixrieseberg.en: Ideal AI interaction is asynchronous: fire tasks, don't supervise; debug workflows with Claude, not just correct errors.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，理想 AI 交互是异步：发出任务不监督；用 Claude 调试工作流，而非仅纠正错误。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的规模扩张收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Giving models tools like search, code execution, and browser access enables autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 赋予模型搜索、代码执行和浏览器访问等工具，使其能够超越静态权重，实现自主的智能体式行为。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的扩展轴，可以改善推理并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失的能力。

oriol.en: The bitter lesson suggests general systems will eventually outperform specialized scaffolding.
oriol.zh: 苦涩的教训表明，通用系统最终将胜过专门的脚手架。

lambert.en: RLHF is the most popular fine-tuning technique and will persist due to industry investment.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 是最流行的微调技术，并将因行业投资而持续存在。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality matters more than algorithm choice; better data yields 10x improvement.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练中数据质量比算法选择更重要；更好的数据带来 10 倍提升。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 是后训练的最大突破，实现了推理和工具使用。

lambert.en: Open models will be the engine for AI research for the next 10 years, despite lagging behind closed models.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，尽管落后于封闭模型。

lambert.en: Chinese labs focus on meticulous engineering, not paradigm invention; open weights gain US influence.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，中国实验室专注于精细工程而非范式发明；开放权重赢得美国市场影响力。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is dead; trust intuition and adapt processes per project.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，认为传统设计流程已过时，设计师应信任直觉并针对每个项目调整流程。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers now spend 30-40% time mocking up, down from 60-70%.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月，强调设计流程已死，设计师花在模拟上的时间从 60-70%降至 30-40%。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years; ship early, iterate fast.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月，设计愿景从 2-5 年缩短至 3-6 个月，强调快速发布和迭代。

jennywen.en: Designers must be block-shaped generalists; taste alone won't save them, judgment and vision are key.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月，提出设计师应成为块状通才，仅靠品味不够，判断力和愿景是关键。

jennywen.en: Speed is not an improvement; 'everyone is using it' is not a good design argument.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出速度并非改进，'人人都在用'不是好的设计论据。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training data is key; curiosity-driven exploration prevents overfitting and enables better generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，强调超越训练数据的泛化是关键，好奇心驱动的探索能防止过拟合，实现更好的泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics lacks internet-scale data; must leverage all data sources, including simulation and real-world, for pretraining and post-training.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 年到 2026 年，始终认为机器人领域缺乏互联网规模的数据，必须利用所有数据源（包括仿真和真实世界）进行预训练和后训练。

pathak.en: A universal robot brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot across form factors and tasks.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，提出通用机器人大脑，类似语言领域的 ChatGPT，可驱动任何形态和任务的机器人。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary challenge in robotics; it is a technical problem, not just business, requiring rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，强调部署是机器人领域的主要挑战，是技术问题而非单纯商业问题，需要严格测试。

pathak.en: Video data alone is insufficient; simulation and real-world data are needed to bridge the sim-to-real gap.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，指出仅靠视频数据不足，需要仿真和真实数据弥合仿真到现实的差距。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate risks in real-world use.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐迫在眉睫；迭代部署有助于在实际使用中学习和降低风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织带来的权力集中。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码的堆栈；现代工具使其可解释，这与过去的看法相反。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，例如在盲弯处向前轻推。

kendall.en: Hybrid rule-based and learned systems often get the worst of both worlds; camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 混合规则和学习的系统往往两头不讨好；纯摄像头可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver requires massive data, compute, and world models for simulation; infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation.
kendall.zh: 扩展通用 AI 驾驶员需要海量数据、算力和用于仿真的世界模型；基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in the short and medium term; autonomous driving can reduce accidents to near zero by eliminating human error.
kendall.zh: 短期内消费级车辆将超过机器人出租车；自动驾驶可通过消除人为错误将事故降至接近零。

karpathy.en: Scaling Transformers with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities; vision alone suffices for driving; physics may have exploitable bugs.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年：认为缩放 Transformer 并采用下一个词预测可产生涌现能力；纯视觉足以支撑自动驾驶；物理世界可能存在可利用的漏洞。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy; end-to-end learning beats modular; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer; cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年：强调合成数据重要但需保持熵；端到端学习优于模块化；人形机器人可受益于汽车技术迁移；认知核心可极小。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as OS, prompts as programs; agents need a decade; pre-training is crappy evolution; RL needs better credit assignment.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年：提出软件 3.0，将 LLM 视为操作系统、提示词为程序；智能体需十年发展；预训练像糟糕的进化；强化学习需改进信用分配。

karpathy.en: I haven't coded since December; directing agents is the skill; agent-first tools; open-source lags but healthy; models are jagged, not general.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年：自去年 12 月起不再亲自写代码，指导智能体成为关键技能；工具应面向智能体；开源落后但有益；模型能力参差不齐，并非通用。

karpathy.en: Vibe coding raises floor; agentic engineering keeps quality; LLMs are ghosts, not animals; understanding remains human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年：随性编程提高下限，智能体工程保持质量；LLM 是幽灵而非动物；理解仍是人类瓶颈。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 还需十年以上；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading; real progress needs deep human evaluation, not leaderboard optimization.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性；真正的进步需要深度人类评估，而非排行榜优化。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next post-training stage, simulating real-world tasks for models.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，模拟真实任务供模型学习。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment is critical; AI can hallucinate, and doctors may underperform AI alone due to anchoring.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，人类判断至关重要；AI 可能产生幻觉，医生可能因锚定效应而表现不如单独使用 AI。

edwinchen.en: Quality data and taste are paramount; labs diverge in objective functions, shaping diverse AI models.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据和品味至关重要；不同实验室的目标函数不同，塑造出多样化的 AI 模型。

carlpei.en: Survival is core; build brand via purpose and consistent execution, start simple, hire hungry talent.
carlpei.zh: 生存是核心；通过使命和一致执行打造品牌，从简单产品起步，雇佣有饥饿感的人才。

carlpei.en: Smartphone future is generative UI and agentic AI; hardware margins low, evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机的未来在于生成式界面和智能体式 AI；硬件利润率低，需超越硬件。

carlpei.en: AI models commoditize; focus on applied AI for consumers, trust and privacy critical.
carlpei.zh: AI 模型商品化；聚焦消费者应用 AI，信任和隐私至关重要。

carlpei.en: Design differentiates in mature categories; AI is ingredient, not hype; marketing arbitrage via content.
carlpei.zh: 在成熟品类中，设计是差异化关键；AI 是成分而非噱头；通过内容实现营销套利。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by wearables; only brain-computer interface could; apps will disappear.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机不会被可穿戴设备取代；只有脑机接口可能；应用将消失。

turley.en: Model is the product; ship fast, learn from real use, natural language interface evolves beyond chat.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；快速发布并从真实使用中学习，自然语言界面将超越聊天形态。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity separated; rigorous frontier model process, accelerated product development.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度分离；前沿模型严格流程，产品开发加速。
