turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product investments, model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动且功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人；推理模型产品化。

turley.en: Pricing evolves with technology; unlimited plans may become unsustainable; curiosity key skill.
turley.zh: 定价随技术演变；无限套餐可能不可持续；好奇心是关键技能。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems for broad impact, not narrow applications.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，强调 AI 在科学中应瞄准根节点问题以产生广泛影响，而非狭窄应用。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，认为大模型的幻觉在配合真值检测器时可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，指出大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，强调后训练结合强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 始终认为，可解释性重要但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI knowledge and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack grounded experience.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，强调具身对 AI 知识落地和减少幻觉至关重要，LLM 因缺乏具身经验而产生幻觉。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning is best for low-level control, while LLMs handle high-level planning; RL is a cherry on top.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，认为强化学习适合底层控制，LLM 负责高层规划，强化学习只是点缀。

jimfan.en: Data is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，指出机器人领域数据是主要瓶颈，仿真和世界模型生成的合成数据是未来。

jimfan.en: The physical Turing test—a robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，提出具身 AI 的终极挑战是物理图灵测试，即机器人清理杂乱房间。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning progresses well, but system one low-level control remains the hardest part of embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，认为系统二推理进展顺利，但系统一底层控制仍是具身 AI 最难的部分。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities, with video learning and generalist agents as steps toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样增强人类能力，视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）是迈向 AGI 的步骤。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs in AI, with local language models transforming education; AI safety remains unsolved.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调非洲在 AI 上实现跨越式发展，本地语言模型可革新教育，但 AI 安全仍是未解难题。

nando.en: Emphasizes diversity, inclusion, and human skills like communication as essential for beneficial AI.
nando.zh: 始终强调多样性和包容性，以及沟通等人文技能对构建有益 AI 至关重要。

nando.en: From focusing on technical paths (video, agents) to broader societal impact and safety challenges.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年关注技术路径（视频、智能体）转向 2026 年更广泛的社会影响和安全挑战。

nando.en: Challenges conventional wisdom: Africa not behind, AI safety open, and learning from nature.
nando.zh: 始终挑战常规认知：非洲并不落后，AI 安全尚无解，以及从自然中学习。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能显著提升智能。

sholto.en: RL on verifiable rewards is key; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, automating white-collar jobs by 2027-28.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键；预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，并在 2027-28 年前自动化白领工作。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence expands capabilities, and coding is the most tractable domain.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为强化学习是新的扩展轴；更长的智能体连贯性扩展能力，编码是最易处理的领域。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使得工具和编排比原始智能更重要；算力成为瓶颈。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator for AI progress; verifiability drives capability and economic impact.
sholto.zh: 始终，我坚持编码是 AI 进步的领先指标；可验证性驱动能力和经济影响。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can match larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年：仅靠 Scaling 可能无法解决常识问题；拥有更好数据和算法的小模型可以媲美大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; AI methods interpolate human knowledge, not transcend it.
yejin.zh: 2023 至 2025 年：数据是根本瓶颈；AI 方法是在插值人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning requires careful engineering; RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 2025 年：强化学习需要精细工程；RLVR 可能降低 pass@k，即使 best-of-n 有所提升。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; debiasing internet is impossible, so embrace pluralism.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：多元对齐尊重人类多元价值观；互联网去偏不可行，因此应拥抱多元主义。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; RL during pre-training improves reasoning.
yejin.zh: 2026 年：小语言模型借助多样合成数据可变得强大；预训练期间的强化学习提升推理能力。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，强调设计师应会写代码以建立同理心并加快交付；优先追求速度和熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘和差异化；品牌指南应是动态平台，而非僵化规则。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，将设计提升为战略武器，创始人需阐明设计如何助力公司获胜。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元原型而非克隆；赋予设计师自主权以促进成长。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool; people join a brand, not just a company.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调品牌叙事是招聘工具，人们加入的是品牌而非仅公司。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, using AI as a creative partner; design tools evolve with code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 4 月，设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，将 AI 视为创意伙伴；设计工具随代码作为事实来源而演进。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, paid iteratively; rapid scrappy experimentation maximizes learning; avoid over-visionary bets on future models.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 4 月，质量如同债务，需迭代偿还；快速粗糙的实验最大化学习；避免过度远见押注未来模型。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月，掌握端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should show craft and intentionality, not process; side projects and paid tests reveal true skill.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月，作品集应展示工艺与意图而非过程；副项目和付费测试更能揭示真实技能。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; ignoring it is like ignoring the early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月，在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为常态；忽视它如同早期忽视互联网。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary for coding; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 自然语言不会是编程的主要方式；示例和直接操作更好。

truell.en: Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major AI progress driver.
truell.zh: 测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练缩放，成为下一个主要 AI 进步驱动力。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification; humans stay in driver's seat.
truell.zh: 编程从代码转向意图规范；人类保持主导地位。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其在速度和成本方面。

truell.en: Agents promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration central.
truell.zh: 智能体有前景但尚不实用；迭代式人机协作是核心。

leike.en: AI safety research is under-explored; empirical work and collaboration are key, and talent gap exceeds funding gap.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全研究尚待深入，实证研究与协作是关键，人才缺口比资金缺口更大。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability; alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法规模化，需要可扩展监督和可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: Automated alignment research and model organisms can bootstrap progress; empirical testing is crucial.
leike.zh: 2023 年：自动化对齐研究和模型生物可助推进展，实证测试至关重要。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone insufficient; external oversight and third-party testing needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化受损，仅靠后训练不够，需要外部监管和第三方测试。

leike.en: Even if alignment fails, raising misuse cost via techniques like Sophon may buy time; doomerism is defeatism.
leike.zh: 2024 年：即使对齐失败，通过 Sophon 等技术提高滥用成本可争取时间；悲观主义是失败主义。

abbeel.en: Self-play and imitation learning are strong signals for robot skill acquisition; RL needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，强调自博弈和模仿学习是机器人技能获取的强信号，并指出强化学习需要分层推理以解决长时程任务。

abbeel.en: Combining unsupervised learning with RL boosts sample efficiency; hard-coding prior knowledge can limit performance.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，提出无监督学习与强化学习结合可大幅提升样本效率，并认为硬编码先验知识可能限制性能。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks, hinting at general intelligence.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，指出预训练语言模型可将推理能力迁移至非语言任务，暗示通用智能的潜力。

abbeel.en: Consistently values learning from data over hard-coding, and sees RL as key for embodied intelligence.
abbeel.zh: 始终重视从数据中学习而非硬编码，并视强化学习为实现具身智能的关键。

shazeer.en: Next-token prediction is AI-complete; scaling with compute and data yields intelligence, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为下一个词预测是 AI 完备问题，规模扩张带来智能，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are key near-term opportunities; modular architectures enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他强调推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期关键机会，模块化架构实现高效规模扩张。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components could replace retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动数据；模块化持续学习可替代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and RL are crucial for AGI.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为测试时算力扩展推动进步但不足以实现 AGI，智能体能力和强化学习对 AGI 至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped economically; coding is underhyped as it enables AI self-acceleration; open-source narrows gap.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 的经济影响被低估，编码应用被低估因为它加速 AI 自身发展，开源缩小差距。
